# Sanktionshot dämpar oljan – bitcoin rusar

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-08-25  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The EFN Morgon hosts discussed new US sanctions threats against Iran, which weighed slightly on oil, alongside tariff tensions between the US and Canada and between the US and China. They also covered stubbornly high US long-term rates and bitcoin's rally from about $65k to $80k, seen as a hedge against a weaker dollar. On Swedish markets, they noted steady outlooks from Swedbank and SEB and a calm stock market. Among companies, they were positive on Nibe, gave a 'do not subscribe' view on the newly listed Ellos after its first report, and briefly covered SSAB and Salmar.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 NIBE-B — Nibe | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Growth improved in the last report and German heat pump subsidy applications rose 113% in June. Hosts see it as a good thematic stock to own.

#### Reasoning

The hosts think Nibe is back on track: growth improved in the latest report and German subsidy data point the same way. They see climate and heat as long-term themes and note the push into air-to-air heat pumps and cooling products. They also say the return depends on when you bought and that the Stoves unit took a hit from US-Canada tariffs, so conviction is modest.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the US-Canada tariff conflict escalates further and hurts Stoves
- if German heat pump demand turns down again
- if growth recovery stalls in coming reports

> *"Det känns som en tematiskt bra aktie att äga med tanke på vad som händer i världen med klimatet och värme och torka och allt möjligt."*

---

### ⛔ ELLOS — Ellos | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

A host said they recommended not subscribing to the IPO and that it is better to wait a few quarters for the company to prove itself. The first report showed flat profit and a one-off cost.

#### Reasoning

The hosts stand by their earlier 'do not subscribe' call. Their concerns are the ownership of former bondholders with no natural owner, a history of too much debt, a negative tax ruling, and weak performance after the stabilisation buying ended. On the positive side, the gross margin rose 2 points on more own brands and better pricing, and sales were stable. Their view is that other stocks are more attractive, so wait a few quarters.

#### Sell Triggers

- if several quarters show sustained margin gains and profit growth
- if a stable long-term main owner comes in

> *"Jag skulle rekommendera att man inte skulle teckna, att man lika bra kan vänta några kvartal och se om de bevisar sig."*

---
